about.title: About Me
about.bio1: Hello! I'm João Victor, a Backend Software Engineer with 6+ years of experience focused on building and designing scalable systems, distributed applications and high-impact business platforms.
about.bio2: I work across the full software development lifecycle, from architecture design and backend engineering to cloud infrastructure, integrations and production reliability, helping companies transform complex business workflows into maintainable and scalable software solutions.
about.bio3: Throughout my career, I have designed and developed SaaS platforms, enterprise internal systems and data-driven applications, integrating legacy systems, building APIs, automating workflows and improving operational efficiency through engineering best practices.
about.bio4: My work combines backend engineering, cloud architecture and system design, with a strong emphasis on performance, scalability, observability and clean architecture principles.

job1.title: Software Engineer
job1.description: Designed, developed and maintained a scalable B2B SaaS platform focused on lead generation and commercial prospecting. Built modern frontend applications using Vue 3, Node.js and TypeScript. Developed backend APIs using Ruby on Rails with ElasticSearch for advanced search and indexing. Acted as a technical leader within the squad, contributing to architecture decisions, code reviews and engineering best practices.

job2.title: Software Engineer
job2.description: Architected and developed an enterprise web application to unify internal workflows and business systems using Next.js/Vite and NestJS. Integrated legacy enterprise systems including ERP platforms and Azure Active Directory. Optimized internal operational workflows, reducing average task execution time by approximately 80%.

job3.title: Software Engineer
job3.description: Developed features for an HR platform including a facial recognition-based clock-in system, geofencing validation and overtime management. Implemented video upload pipelines using AWS S3 and worked with event-driven architecture using RabbitMQ and Redis for caching. Led the platform migration from Node.js 12 to Node.js 18.

job4.title: Data Engineer
job4.description: Developed a unified credit analysis platform based on large-scale data processing. Built and maintained data pipelines using Python, PySpark and Apache Spark on a Hive-based Data Lake. Implemented asynchronous processing using AWS SQS and utilized Redis as a caching layer to reduce latency in critical data access operations.

e-commerce-app.title: E-commerce Platform
e-commerce-app.shortDescription: Full-featured e-commerce platform with admin dashboard
e-commerce-app.description: A complete e-commerce solution with product listings, shopping cart, checkout process, and admin dashboard. Built with React, Node.js, Express, and MongoDB. Features include user authentication, product management, and order processing.

weather-app.description: A weather application providing real-time weather information and forecasts. Features include current conditions, 5-day forecast, location search, and temperature unit conversion. Built with React and OpenWeather API.

blog-platform.title: Blog Platform
blog-platform.description: A blog platform allowing users to create, edit, and publish articles. Features include rich text editing, categories, tags, and comments. Built with Next.js, Prisma, and PostgreSQL.
